description: Named WSFC / AG listeners / FCI only. Servers without cluster_name are excluded. FCI panels stay empty on AG-on-WSFC unless SQL is an FCI instance.

targets.expr: sum(mssql_hadr_is_hadr_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)
sum(mssql_hadr_is_clustered{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)
count(mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(mssql_hadr_cluster_member_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"} != 1) or vector(0)

count(mssql_hadr_listener_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)

count(mssql_hadr_listener_ip_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} != 0 and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)

count(mssql_hadr_fci_node_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} != 0 and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)

sum(mssql_hadr_fci_is_current_owner{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})) or vector(0)

max by (instance) (mssql_hadr_is_hadr_enabled{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

max by (instance) (mssql_hadr_is_clustered{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))
max by (instance, cluster_name, quorum_type_desc, quorum_state_desc) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max by (instance, cluster_name, quorum_type_desc, quorum_state_desc) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_type{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max by (instance, cluster_name, member_name, member_type_desc, member_state_desc) (mssql_hadr_cluster_member_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max by (instance, cluster_name, member_name, member_type_desc, member_state_desc) (mssql_hadr_cluster_member_quorum_votes{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})

max by (instance, availability_group_name, dns_name, ip_address, is_conformant) (mssql_hadr_listener_info{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

max by (instance, availability_group_name, dns_name, ip_address) (mssql_hadr_listener_port{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

max by (instance, availability_group_name, dns_name, ip_address, state_desc, is_dhcp) (mssql_hadr_listener_ip_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

panels.title: FCI nodes (only when IsClustered=1 - not AG-on-WSFC)

targets.expr: max by (instance, node_name, status_description) (mssql_hadr_fci_node_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

max by (instance, node_name, status_description) (mssql_hadr_fci_is_current_owner{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"}))

panels.title: FCI nodes / current owner (empty if AG uses WSFC but SQL is not an FCI)

targets.expr: mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}
mssql_hadr_cluster_member_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}

mssql_hadr_listener_ip_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", availability_group_name=~"$ag"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})
mssql_hadr_fci_node_status{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})
mssql_hadr_cluster_member_quorum_votes{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}
mssql_hadr_fci_is_current_owner{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_hadr_cluster_quorum_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", cluster_name=~".+"})

title: Collector hadr_cluster
